The '''First Temple of Doellin''' was a massive [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] temple located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Aygion Mountain]]. The temple was the largest Doellin temple in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and contained a vast [[Doellinist Historical Archive|archive]] of writings and artwork from the religion's history.<ref name="Strongholds" />
